verses.zh: 大卫因怕基士的儿子扫罗，躲在洗革拉的时候，有勇士到他那里帮助他打仗。
verses.en: These were the men who joined David in Ziklag, when he was banished[NOTE:1] from the presence of Saul son of Kish. (They were among the warriors who assisted him in battle.
notes: Heb “kept from.”

verses.zh: 他们善于拉弓，能用左右两手甩石射箭，都是便雅悯人扫罗的族弟兄。
verses.en: They were armed with bows and could shoot arrows or sling stones right- or left-handed. They were fellow tribesmen of Saul from Benjamin.[NOTE:1]) These were:[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “ones armed with bow[s], using the right hand and the left hand with stones and with arrows with the bow, from the brothers of Saul from Benjamin.”
The words “These were” have been supplied in the translation for stylistic reasons because of the length of the intervening material since the beginning of the verse.

verses.zh: 为首的是亚希以谢，其次是约阿施，都是基比亚人示玛的儿子。还有亚斯玛威的儿子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，并亚拿突人耶户，
verses.en: Ahiezer, the leader, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Berachah, Jehu the Anathothite,

verses.zh: 基遍人以实买雅〈他在三十人中是勇士，管理他们〉，且有耶利米、雅哈悉、约哈难，和基得拉人约撒拔、
verses.en: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, one of the thirty warriors and their leader, (12:5)[NOTE:1] Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,
notes: In the Hebrew text (BHS) a verse division occurs at this point, and for the remainder of the chapter the verse numbers of the Hebrew Bible differ by one from the English Bible. Thus 1 Chr 12:4b ET = 12:5 HT, and 12:5-40 ET = 12:6-41 HT. Beginning with 13:1 the verse numbers in the ET and HT are again the same.

verses.zh: 伊利乌赛、耶利摩、比亚利雅、示玛利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，
verses.en: (12:6) Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah the Haruphite,

verses.zh: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亚、亚萨列、约以谢、雅朔班，
verses.en: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites,

verses.zh: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。
verses.en: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

verses.zh: 迦得支派中有人到旷野的山寨投奔大卫，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和枪的战士。他们的面貌好像狮子，快跑如同山上的鹿。
verses.en: Some of the Gadites joined David at the stronghold in the wilderness. They were warriors who were trained for battle; they carried shields and spears. They were as fierce as lions and could run as quickly as gazelles across the hills.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “warriors, men of battle for war, prepared with shield and spear, and [like] the face of a lion were their faces, and like gazelles on the hills to hurry.”

verses.zh: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，
verses.en: Ezer was the leader, Obadiah the second-in-command, Eliab the third,

verses.zh: 第四弥施玛拿，第五耶利米，
verses.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

verses.zh: 第六亚太，第七以利业，
verses.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

verses.zh: 第八约哈难，第九以利萨巴，
verses.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

verses.zh: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。
verses.en: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

verses.zh: 这都是迦得人中的军长，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。
verses.en: These Gadites were military leaders; the least led a hundred men, the greatest a thousand.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “one for a hundred the small, and the great for a thousand.” Another option is to translate the preposition ל (lamed) as “against” and to understand this as a hyperbolic reference to their prowess: “the least could stand against a hundred, the greatest against a thousand.”

verses.zh: 正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，他们过河，使一切住平原的人东奔西逃。
verses.en: They crossed the Jordan River[NOTE:1] in the first month,[NOTE:2] when it was overflowing its banks, and routed those living in all the valleys to the east and west.[NOTE:3]
notes: The word “River” is not in the Hebrew text, but has been supplied for clarity.
That is, March-April.
Heb “and they chased all the valleys to the east and to the west.”

verses.zh: 又有便雅悯和犹大人到山寨大卫那里。
verses.en: Some from Benjamin and Judah also came to David’s stronghold.

verses.zh: 大卫出去迎接他们，对他们说：「你们若是和和平平地来帮助我，我心就与你们相契；你们若是将我这无罪的人卖在敌人手里，愿我们列祖的　神察看责罚。」
verses.en: David went out to meet them and said,[NOTE:1] “If you come to me in peace and want to help me, then I will make an alliance with you.[NOTE:2] But if you come to betray me to my enemies when I have not harmed you,[NOTE:3] may the God of our ancestors[NOTE:4] take notice and judge!”
notes: Heb “and David went out before them and answered and said to them.”
Heb “there will be to me concerning you a heart for unity.”
Heb “with no violence in my hands.”
Heb “fathers.”

verses.zh: 那时　神的灵感动那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒，他就说：大卫啊，我们是归于你的！耶西的儿子啊，我们是帮助你的！愿你平平安安，愿帮助你的也都平安！因为你的　神帮助你。大卫就收留他们，立他们作军长。
verses.en: But a spirit[NOTE:1] empowered[NOTE:2] Amasai, the leader of the group of warriors known as the Thirty, and he said:[NOTE:3] “We are yours, O David! We support[NOTE:4] you, O son of Jesse! May you greatly prosper.[NOTE:5] May those who help you prosper.[NOTE:6] Indeed[NOTE:7] your God helps you!”So David accepted them and made them leaders of raiding bands.
notes: Perhaps “the Spirit,” but the text has simply רוּחַ (ruakh) with no article (suggesting an indefinite reference).
Heb “clothed.”
The words “and he said” are supplied in the translation for clarity and for stylistic reasons.
Heb “are with.”
Heb “Peace, peace to you.” The Hebrew term שָׁלוֹם (shalom, “peace”) is repeated to emphasize degree.
Heb “and peace to the one who helps you.”
Or “for.”

verses.zh: 大卫从前与非利士人同去，要与扫罗争战，有些玛拿西人来投奔大卫，他们却没有帮助非利士人；因为非利士人的首领商议，打发他们回去，说：「恐怕大卫拿我们的首级，归降他的主人扫罗。」
verses.en: Some men from Manasseh joined[NOTE:1] David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (But in the end they did not help the Philistines because, after taking counsel, the Philistine lords sent David away, saying, “It would be disastrous for us if he deserts to his master Saul.”)[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “fell upon,” here in a good sense.
Heb “and they did not help them for by counsel they sent him away, the lords of the Philistines, saying, ‘With our heads he will fall to his master Saul.’”

verses.zh: 大卫往洗革拉去的时候，有玛拿西人的千夫长押拿、约撒拔、耶叠、米迦勒、约撒拔、以利户、洗勒太都来投奔他。
verses.en: When David[NOTE:1] went to Ziklag, the men of Manasseh who joined him were Adnach, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, leaders of 1,000 soldiers each in the tribe of Manasseh.
notes: Heb “he”; the referent (David) has been specified in the translation for clarity.

verses.zh: 这些人帮助大卫攻击群贼；他们都是大能的勇士，且作军长。
verses.en: They helped David fight against raiding bands, for all of them were warriors and leaders in the army.

verses.zh: 那时天天有人来帮助大卫，以致成了大军，如　神的军一样。
verses.en: Each day men came to help David until his army became very large.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “for at the time of day in a day they were coming to David to help him until [there was] a great camp like the camp of God.” The term אֱלֹהִים (ʾelohim, “God”) is probably used idiomatically here to indicate the superlative.

verses.zh: 预备打仗的兵来到希伯仑见大卫，要照着耶和华的话将扫罗的国位归与大卫。他们的数目如下：
verses.en: The following is a record of the armed warriors who came with their leaders and joined David in Hebron in order to make David king in Saul’s place, in accordance with the Lord’s decree:[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “these are the numbers of the heads of the forces armed for battle [who] came to David in Hebron to turn over the kingdom of Saul to him according to the mouth of the Lord.”

verses.zh: 犹大支派，拿盾牌和枪预备打仗的有六千八百人。
verses.en: From Judah came 6,800 trained warriors carrying shields and spears.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “the sons of Judah, carrying shield and spear, [were] 6,800 armed for battle.”

verses.zh: 西缅支派，能上阵大能的勇士有七千一百人。
verses.en: From Simeon there were 7,100 warriors.

verses.zh: 利未支派有四千六百人。
verses.en: From Levi there were 4,600.

verses.zh: 耶何耶大是亚伦家的首领，跟从他的有三千七百人。
verses.en: Jehoiada, the leader of Aaron’s descendants, brought 3,700 men with him,

verses.zh: 还有少年大能的勇士撒督，同着他的有族长二十二人。
verses.en: along with Zadok, a young warrior, and 22 leaders from his family.

verses.zh: 便雅悯支派，扫罗的族弟兄也有三千人，他们向来大半归顺扫罗家。
verses.en: From Benjamin, Saul’s tribe,[NOTE:1] there were 3,000, most of whom, up to that time, had been loyal to Saul.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “from the sons of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul.”
Heb “and until then, the majority of them were keeping the charge of the house of Saul.”

verses.zh: 以法莲支派大能的勇士，在本族着名的有二万零八百人。
verses.en: From Ephraim there were 20,800 warriors, who had brought fame to their families.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “men of names for the house of their fathers.”

verses.zh: 玛拿西半支派，册上有名的共一万八千人，都来立大卫作王。
verses.en: From the half-tribe of Manasseh there were 18,000 who had been designated by name to come and make David king.

verses.zh: 以萨迦支派，有二百族长都通达时务，知道以色列人所当行的；他们族弟兄都听从他们的命令。
verses.en: From Issachar there were 200 leaders and all their relatives at their command—they understood the times and knew what Israel should do.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “from the sons of Issachar, knowers of understanding for times to know what Israel should do, their heads [were] 200, and all their brothers according to their mouth.”

verses.zh: 西布伦支派，能上阵用各样兵器打仗、行伍整齐、不生二心的有五万人。
verses.en: From Zebulun there were 50,000 warriors who were prepared for battle, equipped with all kinds of weapons, and ready to give their undivided loyalty.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “from Zebulun, those going out for battle, prepared for war with all weapons of war, 50,000, and to help without a heart and a heart.”

verses.zh: 拿弗他利支派，有一千军长；跟从他们、拿盾牌和枪的有三万七千人。
verses.en: From Naphtali there were 1,000 officers, along with 37,000 men carrying shields and spears.

verses.zh: 但支派，能摆阵的有二万八千六百人。
verses.en: From Dan there were 28,600 men prepared for battle.

verses.zh: 亚设支派，能上阵打仗的有四万人。
verses.en: From Asher there were 40,000 warriors prepared for battle.

verses.zh: 约旦河东的流便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派，拿着各样兵器打仗的有十二万人。
verses.en: From the other side of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, there were 120,000 men armed with all kinds of weapons.

verses.zh: 以上都是能守行伍的战士，他们都诚心来到希伯仑，要立大卫作以色列的王。以色列其余的人也都一心要立大卫作王。
verses.en: All these men were warriors who were ready to march.[NOTE:1] They came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel by acclamation;[NOTE:2] all the rest of the Israelites also were in agreement that David should become king.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “all these [were] men of war, helpers of the battle line.” The present translation assumes an emendation of עֹדְרֵי (ʿodere, “helpers of”) to עֹרְכֵי, (ʿorekhe, “prepared for”).
Heb “with a complete heart they came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel.”
Heb “and also all the rest of Israel [was of] one mind to make David king.”

verses.zh: 他们在那里三日，与大卫一同吃喝，因为他们的族弟兄给他们预备了。
verses.en: They spent three days feasting[NOTE:1] there with David, for their relatives had given them provisions.
notes: Heb “eating and drinking.”

verses.zh: 靠近他们的人以及以萨迦、西布伦、拿弗他利人将许多面饼、无花果饼、干葡萄、酒、油，用驴、骆驼、骡子、牛驮来，又带了许多的牛和羊来，因为以色列人甚是欢乐。
verses.en: Also their neighbors, from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen. There were large supplies of flour, fig cakes, raisins, wine, olive oil, beef, and lamb,[NOTE:1] for Israel was celebrating.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “cattle and sheep.”
Heb “for there was joy in Israel.”
